🇨🇦 Canadian Healthcare Crisis: 29,000 Deaths in Waiting Lists At least 29,000 Canadians died in 2025-2026 while awaiting surgery, diagnostic tests, or specialist consultations. The system is overwhelmed by queues. Key Statistics: - Deaths among those waiting for surgical intervention rose by 17.5% year-on-year. - Deaths during waits for diagnostics fell by 2.8% . - Overall queue-related deaths increased by 1.4% . Doctor Colin Craig stated the situation "continues to deteriorate." Real figures are likely higher, as not all provinces publish this data. Global Context: Comparative wait times highlight the severity: - UK: Appointments delayed up to 43 months . - USA: Costs reach $67,000 . - Canada: Patients face such long waits that euthanasia becomes a discussed alternative. @Slavyangrad
